title: The Drownlight F1 - The Oil Stores
_note: Drownlight family ANCHOR (drownlight_f1): the keeper's hymn played straight — D minor, 3/4, 76 BPM. Flute lead (the motif), harp-pluck arpeggio, warm pad, walking triangle bass, and the lens clockwork ticking softly on every beat. Cold, tended, patient. 16 bars, the last leans home.
